title: LSC Pre-BEST-2 Freeze Package: Constrained Phenomenological Validation Framework for Gallium/BEST Neutrino Anomaly Analysis
description: Local release-candidate metadata draft for a pre-BEST-2 freeze archive. The package presents LSC as a constrained phenomenological validation framework for comparing structured Gallium/BEST-style anomaly hypotheses against null, normalization-only, cross-section/systematics, sterile-neutrino, detector/systematics, and LSC-specific models. It includes canonicalization outputs, validation infrastructure, implementation templates, external-audit integration, provenance manifests, request-for-data materials, and final human-review checklists. The package does not claim confirmed new physics, sterile-neutrino exclusion, or a completed BEST-2 validation.
